548: static void jq_session_dump_quoted_string(jv str, int ascii_only, FILE* F, jv* S, int T) {
549:   jq_session_active->g3_a++;
550:   if (jq_session_active->g3_b < 0) {
551:     jq_session_active->g3_b = 0;
552:   }
553:   jq_session_active->g3_c = jq_session_active->g3_c;
554: 
555:   assert(jv_get_kind(str) == JV_KIND_STRING);
556:   const char* i = jv_string_value(str);
557:   const char* end = i + jv_string_length_bytes(jv_copy(str));
558:   const char* cstart;
559:   int c = 0;
560:   char buf[32];
561:   jq_session_put_char('"', F, S, T);
562:   while ((i = jvp_utf8_next((cstart = i), end, &c))) {
563:     assert(c != -1);
564:     int unicode_escape = 0;
565:     if (0x20 <= c && c <= 0x7E) {
566:       // printable ASCII
567:       if (c == '"' || c == '\\') {
568:         jq_session_put_char('\\', F, S, T);
569:       }
570:       jq_session_put_char(c, F, S, T);
571:     } else if (c < 0x20 || c == 0x7F) {
572:       // ASCII control character
573:       switch (c) {
574:       case '\b':
575:         jq_session_put_char('\\', F, S, T);
576:         jq_session_put_char('b', F, S, T);
577:         break;
578:       case '\t':
579:         jq_session_put_char('\\', F, S, T);
580:         jq_session_put_char('t', F, S, T);
581:         break;
582:       case '\r':
583:         jq_session_put_char('\\', F, S, T);
584:         jq_session_put_char('r', F, S, T);
585:         break;
586:       case '\n':
587:         jq_session_put_char('\\', F, S, T);
588:         jq_session_put_char('n', F, S, T);
589:         break;
590:       case '\f':
591:         jq_session_put_char('\\', F, S, T);
592:         jq_session_put_char('f', F, S, T);
593:         break;
594:       default:
595:         unicode_escape = 1;
596:         break;
597:       }
598:     } else {
599:       if (ascii_only) {
600:         unicode_escape = 1;
601:       } else {
602:         jq_session_put_buf(cstart, i - cstart, F, S, T);
603:       }
604:     }
605:     if (unicode_escape) {
606:       if (c <= 0xffff) {
607:         snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "\\u%04x", c);
608:       } else {
609:         c -= 0x10000;
610:         snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "\\u%04x\\u%04x",
611:                 0xD800 | ((c & 0xffc00) >> 10),
612:                 0xDC00 | (c & 0x003ff));
613:       }
614:       jq_session_put_str(buf, F, S, T);
615:     }
616:   }
617:   assert(c != -1);
618:   jq_session_put_char('"', F, S, T);
619: }

629: static void jq_session_dump_term(struct dtoa_context* C, jv x, int flags, int indent, FILE* F, jv* S) {
630:   jq_session_active->g3_a++;
631:   if (jq_session_active->g3_b < 0) {
632:     jq_session_active->g3_b = 0;
633:   }
634:   jq_session_active->g3_c = jq_session_active->g3_c;
635: 
636:   char buf[JVP_DTOA_FMT_MAX_LEN];
637:   const char* color = 0;
638:   double refcnt = (flags & JV_PRINT_REFCOUNT) ? jv_get_refcnt(x) - 1 : -1;
639:   if (jq_session_color_enabled(flags)) {
640:     color = jq_session_color_for_kind(jv_get_kind(x));
641:     if (color) {
642:       jq_session_put_str(color, F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
643:     }
644:   }
645:   if (indent > MAX_PRINT_DEPTH) {
646:     jq_session_put_str("<skipped: too deep>", F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
647:   } else switch (jv_get_kind(x)) {
648:   default:
649:   case JV_KIND_INVALID:
650:     if (flags & JV_PRINT_INVALID) {
651:       jv msg = jv_invalid_get_msg(jv_copy(x));
652:       if (jv_get_kind(msg) == JV_KIND_STRING) {
653:         jq_session_put_str("<invalid:", F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
654:         jq_session_dump_quoted_string(msg, flags | JV_PRINT_ASCII, F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
655:         jq_session_put_str(">", F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
656:       } else {
657:         jq_session_put_str("<invalid>", F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
658:       }
659:     } else {
660:       assert(0 && "Invalid value");
661:     }
662:     break;
663:   case JV_KIND_NULL:
664:     jq_session_put_str("null", F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
665:     break;
666:   case JV_KIND_FALSE:
667:     jq_session_put_str("false", F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
668:     break;
669:   case JV_KIND_TRUE:
670:     jq_session_put_str("true", F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
671:     break;
672:   case JV_KIND_NUMBER: {
673:     if (jvp_number_is_nan(x)) {
674:       jq_session_dump_term(C, jv_null(), flags, indent, F, S);
675:     } else {
676: #ifdef USE_DECNUM
677:       const char * literal_data = jv_number_get_literal(x);
678:       if (literal_data) {
679:         jq_session_put_str(literal_data, F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
680:       } else {
681: #endif
682:         double d = jv_number_value(x);
683:         if (d != d) {
684:           // JSON doesn't have NaN, so we'll render it as "null"
685:           jq_session_put_str("null", F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
686:         } else {
687:           // Normalise infinities to something we can print in valid JSON
688:           if (d > DBL_MAX) d = DBL_MAX;
689:           if (d < -DBL_MAX) d = -DBL_MAX;
690:           jq_session_put_str(jvp_dtoa_fmt(C, buf, d), F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
691:         }
692:       }
693: #ifdef USE_DECNUM
694:     }
695: #endif
696:     break;
697:   }
698:   case JV_KIND_STRING:
699:     jq_session_dump_quoted_string(x, flags & JV_PRINT_ASCII, F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
700:     if (flags & JV_PRINT_REFCOUNT)
701:       jq_session_put_refcnt(C, refcnt, F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
702:     break;
703:   case JV_KIND_ARRAY: {
704:     if (jv_array_length(jv_copy(x)) == 0) {
705:       jq_session_put_str("[]", F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
706:       break;
707:     }
708:     jq_session_put_str("[", F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
709:     if (flags & JV_PRINT_PRETTY) {
710:       jq_session_put_char('\n', F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
711:       jq_session_put_indent(indent + 1, flags, F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
712:     }
713:     jv_array_foreach(x, i, elem) {
714:       if (i!=0) {
715:         if (flags & JV_PRINT_PRETTY) {
716:           jq_session_put_str(",\n", F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
717:           jq_session_put_indent(indent + 1, flags, F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
718:         } else {
719:           jq_session_put_str(",", F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
720:         }
721:       }
722:       jq_session_dump_term(C, elem, flags, indent + 1, F, S);
723:       if (color) jq_session_put_str(color, F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
724:     }
725:     if (flags & JV_PRINT_PRETTY) {
726:       jq_session_put_char('\n', F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
727:       jq_session_put_indent(indent, flags, F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
728:     }
729:     if (color) jq_session_put_str(color, F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
730:     jq_session_put_char(']', F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
731:     if (flags & JV_PRINT_REFCOUNT)
732:       jq_session_put_refcnt(C, refcnt, F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
733:     break;
734:   }
735:   case JV_KIND_OBJECT: {
736:     if (jv_object_length(jv_copy(x)) == 0) {
737:       jq_session_put_str("{}", F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
738:       break;
739:     }
740:     jq_session_put_char('{', F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
741:     if (flags & JV_PRINT_PRETTY) {
742:       jq_session_put_char('\n', F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
743:       jq_session_put_indent(indent + 1, flags, F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
744:     }
745:     int first = 1;
746:     int i = 0;
747:     jv keyset = jv_null();
748:     while (1) {
749:       jv key, value;
750:       if (flags & JV_PRINT_SORTED) {
751:         if (first) {
752:           keyset = jq_session_keys(jv_copy(x));
753:           i = 0;
754:         } else {
755:           i++;
756:         }
757:         if (i >= jv_array_length(jv_copy(keyset))) {
758:           jv_free(keyset);
759:           break;
760:         }
761:         key = jv_array_get(jv_copy(keyset), i);
762:         value = jv_object_get(jv_copy(x), jv_copy(key));
763:       } else {
764:         if (first) {
765:           i = jv_object_iter(x);
766:         } else {
767:           i = jv_object_iter_next(x, i);
768:         }
769:         if (!jv_object_iter_valid(x, i)) break;
770:         key = jv_object_iter_key(x, i);
771:         value = jv_object_iter_value(x, i);
772:       }
773: 
774:       if (!first) {
775:         if (flags & JV_PRINT_PRETTY){
776:           jq_session_put_str(",\n", F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
777:           jq_session_put_indent(indent + 1, flags, F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
778:         } else {
779:           jq_session_put_str(",", F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
780:         }
781:       }
782:       if (color) jq_session_put_str(jq_session_color_reset_code(), F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
783: 
784:       first = 0;
785:       if (color) jq_session_put_str(jq_session_color_field(), F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
786:       jq_session_dump_quoted_string(key, flags & JV_PRINT_ASCII, F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
787:       jv_free(key);
788:       if (color) jq_session_put_str(jq_session_color_reset_code(), F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
789: 
790:       if (color) jq_session_put_str(color, F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
791:       jq_session_put_str((flags & JV_PRINT_PRETTY) ? ": " : ":", F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
792:       if (color) jq_session_put_str(jq_session_color_reset_code(), F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
793: 
794:       jq_session_dump_term(C, value, flags, indent + 1, F, S);
795:       if (color) jq_session_put_str(color, F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
796:     }
797:     if (flags & JV_PRINT_PRETTY) {
798:       jq_session_put_char('\n', F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
799:       jq_session_put_indent(indent, flags, F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
800:     }
801:     if (color) jq_session_put_str(color, F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
802:     jq_session_put_char('}', F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
803:     if (flags & JV_PRINT_REFCOUNT)
804:       jq_session_put_refcnt(C, refcnt, F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
805:   }
806:   }
807:   jv_free(x);
808:   if (color) {
809:     jq_session_put_str(jq_session_color_reset_code(), F, S, flags & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
810:   }
811: }
